info.title: Sebela API
info.description: The content API of sebelapetr.cz. Reads are public; every write needs an API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` and never in the URL. Every route is rate limited and answers failures with the common error shape. `GET /health` reports liveness only.
